after_snippet:
import pandas as pd

# In pandas 3.0.0, dtype inference for strings defaults to StringDtype
df = pd.DataFrame({'A': ['a', 'b', 'c']})
assert str(df['A'].dtype) == 'string', f"Expected string dtype, got {df['A'].dtype}"
before_snippet:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# In pandas 2.3.3, dtype inference for strings defaults to 'object'
df = pd.DataFrame({'A': ['a', 'b', 'c']})
assert df['A'].dtype == np.object_, f"Expected object dtype, got {df['A'].dtype}"
title: Dedicated string data type becomes default (StringDtype for object-containing Series)
